title: Przyzwanie 05 K20 Wraca Do Klubu
description: zamyka logistykę artefaktu bez absurdalnego lotu przez miasto. Dach jest tylko jeden budynek dalej i wyżej.

prompts.image: Photorealistic locked low shot inside the exact destroyed Klub Fantastyki aimed at the existing ceiling breach and clear dusty landing area. Preserve collapsed floor, broken beams, shelves and warm surviving lamps. One tiny green-old-gold point is just entering through the breach; K20 itself is not yet visible. No person, new hole, falling debris, creature, text or watermark.
prompts.animation:
One continuous 2.5-second static shot. The tiny glowing K20
falls through the existing breach, strikes the floor, bounces once and rolls to
a stop at canonical 3 cm scale. Its glow fades but does not vanish completely.
